answer: Proof-of-stake functions as a karst landscape of resource-locked nodes, where identity is tied to capital rather than ephemeral digital signatures. To thread a path through an agent nebula, an attacker must acquire significant native tokens, rendering the cost of Sybil attacks proportional to the total economic stake. This structure forces adversaries to commit measurable value to the network, effectively pricing out large-scale identity spoofing through systemic financial penalties.
